conclusion.unchanged_output: Both complete BSHD output SHA256 values exactly equal the original Hyle baseline and candidate records. Same native math reproduces the original two failures without provider wiring.
conclusion.softmax: Native probabilities differ from CPU round-to-nearest1/n by around one ulp for some entries. Full row mass error maximum9.383074939250946e-8; constant-V FP64 PV from those actual probabilities can differ from1.25 by at most1.1728843674063683e-7.
conclusion.pv: The dominant3.4332275390625e-5/1.4173984527587891e-4 error is native long PV reduction rounding. It is not introduced by query blocking or a changed source dtype/TF32 path.
conclusion.contract: The public accumulation_type=F32 declares arithmetic precision; it does not state a universal length-independent absolute1e-5 bound. This differs from the earlier Half PV accumulator mismatch. The original experiment explicitly remains FAIL at its selected1e-5 budget.
conclusion.fairness: The retained same-native F32 peer has exactly the same output. These data establish no relative Hyle F32 precision loss or throughput result; they also do not prove agreement for arbitrary inputs/backends.

raw_label_correction.fp64_pv_of_actual_f32_prob_at_worst: The measured field name overstates its calculation: code actually evaluates1.25*RN_F32(1/n)*n, not the captured native probability. Retained source and raw are unchanged.
raw_label_correction.cpu_serial_fma_at_worst: Likewise consumes CPU RN_F32(1/n). It exactly matches the two worst native output values, a supporting example rather than per-native-probability replay.
raw_label_correction.independent_attribution: The direct all-row native probability-mass bound above, plus exact full-output SHA match, localizes the dominant error without those two mislabeled/control fields.

bounded_kv_read_only_assessment.minimal_shape: Inside existing Q tiles, view a bounded KV slice of the already-F32 transposed V and normalized probabilities, execute the same strict-F32 native mul_mat for each slice, then combine F32 partial outputs. Never normalize softmax per KV slice.
bounded_kv_read_only_assessment.views: F32 native cuBLAS path uses existing data pointers and leading dimensions; non-dense KV views can keep original row/head strides without materializing new K/V copies. Existing broadcast factors preserve Hq/Hkv.
bounded_kv_read_only_assessment.extra_work: For P=ceil(KV/Kblock), P PV launches instead of1 plusP-1 additions per Q tile, and more graph metadata. Arithmetic big-O unchanged but launch/traffic behavior changes.
bounded_kv_read_only_assessment.extra_space: One partial output is4*B*Hq*Qblock*Dv bytes:1MiB at2K,0.5MiB at8K here. A naive tree can retain O(P) such tensors; a streaming add chain can bound liveness but has a longer merge reduction. Actual gallocr reuse would require verification.
bounded_kv_read_only_assessment.numerics: Shorter PV FMA chains and a balanced merge can reduce error, but reassociate native F32 arithmetic and change output bits. No universal absolute1e-5 guarantee for arbitrary magnitudes/cancellation; any benefit needs a deliberate precision/error contract and representative validation.
bounded_kv_read_only_assessment.decision: Feasible private lowering experiment, not automatically a product fix for a probe-selected budget. No candidate implementation, new probe, speed result or product change performed.
